name: pi-gui
description: Interfaccia grafica accessibile e multi-cartella per l'agente pi

scripts.check: node --check app/server.mjs && node --check app/sistema-guidato-manager.mjs && node --check app/no-workspace-guard.mjs && node --check app/public/auth-flow-core.js && node --check app/public/palette-core.js && node --check app/public/link-core.js && node --check app/public/clipboard-core.js && node --check app/public/attachment-core.js && node --check app/public/view-core.js && node --check app/public/startup-core.js && node --check app/public/updater-core.js && node --check app/public/app.js && node --check scripts/vendor-pi-runtime.mjs && node --check scripts/vendor-sistema-guidato.mjs && node --check scripts/check-release-version.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-production-updater.mjs && npm run updater:pilot:check
scripts.build:desktop: npm run vendor:pi && npm run vendor:sistema:prepare && tauri build
scripts.build:desktop:offline: npm run vendor:pi:check && npm run vendor:sistema:check && tauri build
scripts.build:desktop:production: npm run vendor:pi:check && npm run vendor:sistema:check && npm run updater:production:prepare && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.production.generated.json
